Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and security at MediLink are moving this along and we need the completed SIG questionnaire and supporting artifacts to finish our vendor review. Specifically, the security team has requested the following:

- Latest SOC 2 report (Type II preferred) or SOC 2 bridge
- Executive summary of most recent penetration test (scope, date, critical findings, remediation status)
- ISO statements or attestation (ISO 27001 scope / certificate if available)
- High-level security deck for our architecture/security reviewers
- Answers to a short SIG follow-up (we will send the spreadsheet)

Can you confirm what you can share directly and whether anything requires an NDA or secure transfer? We are targeting a decision window in two weeks, so would appreciate materials by EOD Thursday, Nov 20th if possible.

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. We can absolutely move on this. Quick summary of what we can provide immediately and items that require a secure exchange:

- Pen test executive summary: available immediately (non-sensitive summary); attached below.
- Security deck: available immediately; will share a Drive link.
- ISO 27001 statement: we have a public attestation; attaching a short statement.
- SOC 2 Type II report: we provide the full report under an NDA / secure share; we can provide a redacted executive summary for general review today.
- Completed SIG spreadsheet: we will return the spreadsheet with inline notes; some items pointing to controlled evidence will reference files delivered under NDA.

Proposed delivery plan:
1) Today (Nov 17): Pen test summary + security deck link + ISO statement + redacted SOC 2 executive summary.
2) Nov 19: Completed SIG spreadsheet (first pass).
3) Nov 20: Full SOC 2 report (secure transfer after NDA) and any remaining evidence.

I’ve attached the pen test summary and ISO statement to this reply. For the SOC 2 report transfer I can send a DocuSign + secure drive link once we have a signed NDA. If that timeline doesn’t work, tell us and we’ll prioritize differently.

Action: Marissa, can you coordinate the Drive share for the deck and confirm who at MediLink should get view permissions? Karthik, please add any technical caveats about what we redact in the public SOC 2 summary.

Best,

Hi Elena — looping in a couple technical notes so security has context.

- Pen test: scope = external attack surface + authenticated web app + limited cloud configuration review (GCP). Vendor = SentinelArc (Q3 2025). No P1s. Two P2s were closed within 30 days; one P3 item is in backlog with planned remediation in our Q1 release. The attached summary flags remediation status per finding.
- SOC 2 redaction approach: we typically redact internal usernames, IP addresses, and certain configuration snippets. We do not redact control narratives or testing results. Karthik, feel free to add.
- Drive share: we will share the security deck to elena.ruiz@medilink.com and security@medilink.com only. Access will be viewer only; downloads disabled for the deck file.

Deliverables included in this thread:
- PenTest_Summary_Q3_2025.pdf (attached)

- Redacted SOC 2 exec summary (will follow in a separate email)

Drive link (viewer only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-redwood-sig-share
